branch_definitions.inherited: Accepted actual L7 output I/Z/H entering L8 at coordinate 62. Replace its complete coordinate by nearest-Q24 ties-even of independently propagated original-input L7 binary64; hold actual L8 S11 O and S17 down fixed.
branch_definitions.o: L8 S11 FP16 O-projection coordinate 62. Replace only this word by direct binary64-to-FP16 RNE of authenticated original-input L8 O, retaining native residual arithmetic and actual uncut branches.
branch_definitions.S12: Exact unrounded incoming Q24 plus FP16 S11 O, retaining integer/zero-sign state and independently checked RNE16 projection. Compare accepted scratch to nearest-Q24 original-input binary64 residual.
branch_definitions.down: L8 S17 FP16 down-projection coordinate 62 added to unrounded S12 Q24. Replace only this word by direct FP16 RNE of original-input L8 down.
branch_definitions.S18: Exact S12 Q24 plus FP16 S17 down, followed by unchanged RNE16 projection. Signed decomposition includes inherited drift, O/down drift, original binary64 addition roundoff and final FP16 projection.
branch_definitions.scratch: Replace complete S12 I/Z/H coordinate 62 by nearest-Q24 original-input residual; retain actual S17. This is an exogenous frozen branch cut, not a recomputed L8 MLP.
branch_definitions.scratch_down: Combine the S12 mapping and original-input S17 FP16 mapping, with all other coordinates actual.
branch_definitions.mapped62: Map complete accepted L8-output I/Z/H coordinate 62 to nearest-Q24 original-input L8 S18. Unchanged L9-L13 must reproduce reviewed L9 inherited_native arrays and gate reports bitwise.
